messages:
deploy-bot: DeployCheck: blocked release 20260321-45 — env-parity check failed for service=runtime-inference. Missing keystore key in PROD: inference/s3/encryption

deploy-bot: failing check output:
```
> check: keystore lookup
> env: prod
> path: inference/s3/encryption
> result: NOT_FOUND
```

Olivia: I see the deploybot flagged it during the preflight. Staging has the key set to s3://redwood-inference-cache/encrypt-v2, prod doesn't. Anyone know who touched keystore sync?

Sam: that was my helm override from yesterday — I updated staging values for s3-encrypt and accidentally used a staging-only values file. :grimacing: I did not touch prod secrets.

Jia: can we hotpatch prod with the same keystore entry? Does it require a KMS alias mapping or anything that might break in-flight requests?

Sam: hotpatch is possible but we need a KMS alias mapping update in paramstore; it's low-risk but outside the current change window. I can open a PR for a backfill: https://github.com/redwood/inference-config/pull/842 (contains the keystore entry and notes).

Owen: +1 to caution. Change window closes in ~20m. If we hotpatch now we might violate the release policy and cause surprise for infra teams. Recommend rollback/pin and schedule a hotfix in the next window.

Olivia: Agreed — prefer rollback. This change only targeted staging and slipped through. Let's pin the previous image and unpause the release after rollback. Update release notes to call out env-parity drift and corrective action.

Sam: on it. I'll revert the image tag to redwood/inference:2026-03-18-v5 and push a rollback PR to the release branch. Command I'll run: `./scripts/release pin-image --service runtime-inference --tag 2026-03-18-v5`

deploy-bot: Action: release 20260321-45 paused by Olivia. To proceed after manual actions: run `/release unpause 20260321-45` or requeue with updated image.

Sam: created PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/releases/rollbacks/113 — includes pinned image and a small note in the changelog about keystore parity.

Jia: please also add a short note for SRE to audit the keystore sync job; we should ensure secret sync targets both staging & prod by default.

Owen: I'll open a short runbook task for ops: ticket INF-7210, assign to infra team to verify sync and add a gate in the deploycheck.

Olivia: For release notes: "Release paused — discovered env-parity: missing keystore entry in PROD. Rolled back to previous image. Follow-up hotfix scheduled in next change window; infra will audit keystore sync."

Sam: rollback deployed to canary and prod reverting now. Will post logs when done.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: rollback started by Sam at 2026-03-21T15:12:40Z. Canaries healthy. Prod revert complete at 2026-03-21T15:18:54Z. Release remains paused.

Olivia: Thanks. After infra verifies the keystore sync and we confirm PR #842 + INF-7210, we can reschedule the release and include the keystore update as an explicit, reviewed change.

Sam: noted. Going to follow up with the infra owner in #eng-infra.

Owen: closing loop: INF-7210 created and assigned. I'll add a deploycheck test for keystore path presence so deploybot fails earlier next time.

Olivia: great — thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
